findings.change: Keep exact 268x32 SVG natural size in a 24px leading clip window and extend only the 2px layout rule. No original SVG bytes or glyph paths changed.
Correct dummy-data hierarchy: drop boundary owns both nested documents and Add row; use existing generic Tree API.

findings.before: An extra chevron is rendered on folder row544.
findings.expected: Only the folder icon is visible; no chevron or menu.
findings.change: Use existing showChevron:false for the source fixture.

findings.before: Wrong app glyphs and bottom-left puzzle badges overlap labels; first label App.
findings.expected: Only a centered puzzle glyph in each cell; first 16px at32/20, others 20px at30/18; all Area Name labels at44/46.
findings.change: Use existing iconName with the exact source puzzle assets; remove badge misuse.

findings.before: Empty draft automatically disables button and applies 50% opacity.
findings.expected: Brand-filled, full-opacity button as source; empty submit dispatches nothing.
findings.change: Honor explicit disabled prop only; retain draft.trim() guard before callback.

findings.before: Default/pointer opening auto-focuses Find Apps input, adding a blue ring absent from source resting state.
findings.expected: Pointer/default opening retains resting input; Enter/Space opening focuses search with keyboard visibility; Tab reaches choices; Escape restores trigger.
findings.change: Track activation modality for header action popovers; prevent auto-focus only for pointer/default opening.

findings.node: NavigationHeader app launcher under native ShadowRoot hosting
findings.before: Keyboard Enter opens the correct popup but Radix FocusScope falls back to its container (tabindex=-1), leaving Find Apps unfocused inside ShadowRoot. Standalone keyboard checks pass, so this defect requires an actual native mount.
findings.expected: Enter and Space focus the first owned, enabled focusable descendant in standalone and native modes. Tab reaches applications and Escape restores the owning trigger.
findings.change: The header action owns its open-focus callback. Always prevent Radix default, and explicitly focus its first enabled visible input, button, anchor, select, textarea or valid tabindex descendant only for keyboard activation. Pointer/default opens keep resting input state; no document-global focus lookup is added.

typographyLimit.status: visible intrinsic-width difference remains; do not claim pixel identity
typographyLimit.conclusion: Provided approved Aptos glyph advances plus GPOS reproduce browser measurements exactly. Figma cached HUG frame geometry cannot identify the original font binary/version or shaping behavior while Aptos is missing. The 63px frame is not explained solely by ceil(61.9609). No unsupported global kerning override or business-label width was added.
